notes: Summary: Mid-market product analytics SaaS looking to replace existing LLM provider (legacy provider: OpenAI) with Redwood. Primary evaluation path: Hosted API for quick parity checks -> Dedicated reserved capacity for stable low-latency production. CTO quote: "We need prompt parity and no user-visible regressions; can't ship with hallucination spikes." Use-case details: chat-based support assistant (multi-turn), code-assist in IDE plugin, dense-vector search for docs (embeddings), and reranker for search results. Constraints: must support SSO/SAML for internal agents, audit logs for compliance, EU data residency for enterprise customers. Technical concerns raised on call: tokenization differences causing embedding mismatches, stop-sequence handling differences, and sampling randomness affecting A/B. Pricing: requested committed-flat pricing for Dedicated (3-6 month trial) — AE provided draft pricing deck and an estimated ARR band. POC plan: run 2-week Hosted POC to validate prompt parity and regression harness, then run a 10-business-day Dedicated POC on a small reserved pool (2x A100 equiv) in NA region with canary rollout for EU traffic. Acceptance criteria: 95th pctl latency <120ms for single-turn chat at 50 qps, embedding cosine parity within 0.02 delta baseline, no increase in top-1 hallucination incidents. Action items: SE to provide adapter shim doc for legacy API compatibility, engineering to run tokenization diff tests, legal to review SOC2 artifacts. Notes style: shorthand and call fragments below.
